paragraphs.text: Ari Zirulnik is a senior copywriter for Magicthegathering.com at Wizards of the Coast , working for the company since July 2019.

He writes product overviews and contributes to Magic Story articles. His first visible contribution was the Zendikar Rising storyline update. Ari also contibited to the design of Secret Lair Drop Series: Sheldon's Spellbook , in honor of his friend Sheldon Menery . For Mark Rosewater , he worked on the final design of Mood Swings .
